O1.statement: The first exact twisted-Krylov dependence produces a scalar operator annihilating every rapid-decay period covered by the parent construction.

O2.statement: The operator order equals inverse-support size and is minimal for a generic functional on the complete period solution space.

O3.statement: Eight named benchmark phases reproduce their expected support, order, primitive operator, and exact zero residual.

O4.statement: The exceptional degree-twelve phase (x^4+x)^3 has generic order three, while x^12+x^10+x^3 has exact generic rank eleven.

O5.statement: Seven selected convergent real-line periods satisfy the displayed operators to relative residual at most 1e-12 in the recorded run.
